files.body:
package zdex

import (
	"chain"

	"gno.land/r/demo/defi/grc20reg"
)

// CreatePool seeds a two-sided ugnot/GRC20 pool. The GRC20 must already
// exist (external or internal). Caller sends `amountU` ugnot with the tx
// and must have approved this realm for `amountT` of the token.
func CreatePool(cur realm, tokenKey, symbol string, amountU, amountT, feeBps int64) string {
	assertNotPaused()
	require(cur.Previous().IsUserCall(), "zdex: EOA only")
	require(amountU > 0 && amountT > 0, "zdex: amounts")
	require(amountU >= minListUgnot, "zdex: min 1 GNOT")
	if feeBps == 0 {
		feeBps = defaultFeeBps
	}
	require(validSwapFee(feeBps), "zdex: fee tier 5/30/100")
	require(symbol != "", "zdex: symbol")
	id := poolIDFor(symbol)
	require(tryPool(id) == nil, "zdex: pool exists")

	takeUgnot(cur, amountU)
	caller := cur.Previous().Address()
	ref := tokenPullKey(tokenKey, symbol)
	pullUserToken(0, cur, ref, caller, amountT)

	lp := geoMean(amountU, amountT)
	require(lp > minLiquidity, "zdex: tiny LP")
	lpUser := lp - minLiquidity

	internal := tryTok(symbol) != nil
	if !internal {
		t := grc20reg.Get(ref)
		require(t != nil, "zdex: unknown token")
		require(t.GetSymbol() == symbol, "zdex: symbol mismatch")
	}
	p := &Pool{
		ID:          id,
		Token:       ref,
		Symbol:      symbol,
		Name:        symbol,
		ReserveU:    amountU,
		ReserveT:    amountT,
		TotalLP:     lp,
		FeeBps:      feeBps,
		Creator:     caller,
		ProtocolBps: poolProtocolFeeBps,
		Internal:    internal,
	}
	pools.Set(id, p)
	setPos(id, caller, lpUser)

	chain.Emit("CreatePool", "pool", id, "lp", itoa(lpUser), "creator", caller.String())
	return id
}

// AddLiquidity deposits ugnot (OriginSend) + token in pool ratio.
func AddLiquidity(cur realm, poolID string, amountU, maxToken, minLP int64) int64 {
	assertNotPaused()
	p := getPool(poolID)
	require(!p.Launched || height() >= p.UnlockHeight, "zdex: launch LP locked")
	require(p.ReserveT > 0 && p.TotalLP > 0, "zdex: empty pool")
	require(amountU > 0, "zdex: amountU")
	baseU := p.ReserveU
	if baseU == 0 {
		baseU = p.VirtualU
	}
	require(baseU > 0, "zdex: no ugnot base")
	takeUgnot(cur, amountU)

	tokenIn := MulDiv(amountU, p.ReserveT, baseU)
	require(tokenIn > 0, "zdex: tokenIn")
	require(tokenIn <= maxToken, "zdex: token slippage")

	caller := cur.Previous().Address()
	pullUserToken(0, cur, poolTokRef(p), caller, tokenIn)

	lp := MulDiv(amountU, p.TotalLP, baseU)
	require(lp > 0, "zdex: zero LP")
	require(lp >= minLP, "zdex: min LP")

	harvestLP(p, caller)
	p.ReserveU = add64(p.ReserveU, amountU)
	p.ReserveT = add64(p.ReserveT, tokenIn)
	p.TotalLP = add64(p.TotalLP, lp)
	curLP := int64(0)
	if existing := getPos(poolID, caller); existing != nil {
		curLP = existing.LP
	}
	setPos(poolID, caller, add64(curLP, lp))
	if st := getPos(poolID, caller); st != nil {
		st.RewardDebt = MulDiv(st.LP, p.AccPoints, ptsScale)
	}

	chain.Emit("AddLiquidity", "pool", poolID, "lp", itoa(lp), "provider", caller.String())
	return lp
}

// RemoveLiquidity burns LP and returns ugnot + token. Blocked on launched
// pools until UnlockHeight (and even then the minimum-liquidity lock remains).
func RemoveLiquidity(cur realm, poolID string, lp, minU, minT int64) (int64, int64) {
	assertNotPaused()
	p := getPool(poolID)
	require(height() >= p.UnlockHeight, "zdex: LP locked")
	require(lp > 0, "zdex: lp")
	require(p.TotalLP > minLiquidity, "zdex: no LP")

	caller := cur.Previous().Address()
	st := getPos(poolID, caller)
	require(st != nil && st.LP >= lp, "zdex: insufficient LP")
	harvestLP(p, caller)

	outU := MulDiv(lp, p.ReserveU, p.TotalLP)
	outT := MulDiv(lp, p.ReserveT, p.TotalLP)
	require(outU >= minU && outT >= minT, "zdex: slippage")
	require(outU < p.ReserveU && outT < p.ReserveT, "zdex: would drain")

	p.ReserveU = sub64(p.ReserveU, outU)
	p.ReserveT = sub64(p.ReserveT, outT)
	p.TotalLP = sub64(p.TotalLP, lp)
	setPos(poolID, caller, st.LP-lp)
	if left := getPos(poolID, caller); left != nil {
		left.RewardDebt = MulDiv(left.LP, p.AccPoints, ptsScale)
	}

	sendUgnot(0, cur, caller, outU)
	pushToken(0, cur, poolTokRef(p), caller, outT)

	chain.Emit("RemoveLiquidity", "pool", poolID, "lp", itoa(lp), "provider", caller.String())
	return outU, outT
}

func PoolInfo(poolID string) (reserveU, reserveT, virtualU, totalLP, feeBps int64) {
	p := getPool(poolID)
	return p.ReserveU, p.ReserveT, p.VirtualU, p.TotalLP, p.FeeBps
}

func PositionOf(poolID string, owner address) int64 {
	st := getPos(poolID, owner)
	if st == nil {
		return 0
	}
	return st.LP
}

func PoolCount() int {
	return pools.Size()
}

package zdex

const (
	nativeDenom = "ugnot"
	bpsDen      = int64(10000)

	defaultFeeBps = int64(30)  // 0.30% — standard AMM pool
	launchFeeBps  = int64(100) // kept for existing launched pools only
	maxFeeBps     = int64(100) // 1.00% hard cap (DEX listing)
	minLiquidity  = int64(1000)
	minListUgnot  = int64(1_000_000) // 1 GNOT minimum to open a pool

	// DEX fee tiers (bps of notional). Protocol takes poolProtocolFeeBps of the fee.
	feeTierLow  = int64(5)   // 0.05%
	feeTierMid  = int64(30)  // 0.30%
	feeTierHigh = int64(100) // 1.00%

	// Launch safety — tighter than zSwap, which mints creator tokens unlocked.
	maxCreatorKeepBps  = int64(2000)  // 20%
	minVestBlocks      = int64(28800) // ~1 day at 3s blocks
	minLockBlocks      = int64(28800)
	defaultSnipeBlocks = int64(1000)
	defaultSnipeMaxBps = int64(200) // 2% of real token reserve per tx
	maxSnipeMaxBps     = int64(1000)

	// Fee split of the swap fee: remainder stays in the pool as LP fee.
	// DEX model: no creator cut on CreatePool. Protocol ~1/6 of the swap fee.
	launchCreatorFeeBps  = int64(4000) // legacy launched pools only
	launchProtocolFeeBps = int64(1000) // legacy launched pools only
	poolProtocolFeeBps   = int64(1667) // ~1/6 of fee → protocol; ~5/6 → LPs

	ptsScale             = int64(1_000_000_000)
	defaultEpochBlocks   = int64(28800) // ~1 day
	defaultFeeShareBps   = int64(8000)  // 80% of protocol ugnot → points pot
)

func validSwapFee(bps int64) bool {
	return bps == feeTierLow || bps == feeTierMid || bps == feeTierHigh
}

type Pool struct {
	ID           string
	Token        string // GRC20 registry key or internal key; pair is always ugnot / Token
	Symbol       string
	Name         string
	ReserveU     int64 // real ugnot
	ReserveT     int64 // real token
	VirtualU     int64 // pricing offset (one-sided launch)
	TotalLP      int64
	FeeBps       int64
	Creator      address
	CreatorBps   int64 // share of fee (of the fee, not of notional)
	ProtocolBps  int64
	Decimals     int64
	AccruedCreatorU  int64
	AccruedCreatorT  int64
	AccruedProtocolU int64
	AccruedProtocolT int64
	UnlockHeight int64 // LP may be removed at/after this height; 0 = unlocked
	SnipeUntil   int64
	SnipeMaxBps  int64
	Launched     bool
	Internal     bool // token minted by this realm
	AccPoints    int64 // cumulative LP points per share * ptsScale
}

type Position struct {
	LP         int64
	RewardDebt int64 // LP * AccPoints / ptsScale at last harvest
}

type Score struct {
	Life     int64
	Epoch    int64
	EpochID  uint64
	Closed   int64
	ClaimedID uint64
}

type Order struct {
	ID         uint64
	Maker      address
	PoolID     string
	GiveUgnot  bool  // true = bid (escrow ugnot, want token)
	GiveAmt    int64 // remaining give
	WantAmt    int64 // remaining want
	ExpireH    int64 // 0 = never
	AllOrNone  bool
}

type Vesting struct {
	Symbol  string
	Owner   address
	Total   int64
	Claimed int64
	StartH  int64
	EndH    int64
}

package incentives

import (
	"gno.land/p/nt/markdown/sanitize/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/ufmt/v0"
)

func Render(path string) string {
	out := "# zdex incentives v2\n\n"
	out += "Sidecar gauges on DexPkg. Native `ugnot` via OriginSend. Lump `Fund` or timed `FundProgram`. LP Claim uses LastLP; does not call zdex swap or LP.\n\n"
	if paused {
		out += "> [!CAUTION]\n> Funding is paused. Claim still works.\n\n"
	}
	out += ufmt.Sprintf("* Version: **%s**\n* Dex: `%s`\n* Admin: `%s`\n\n", Version(), DexPkg(), admin.String())

	out += "## Gauges\n\n"
	if gauges.Size() == 0 {
		out += "_None yet._\n\n"
	} else {
		out += "| Pool | acc | funded | on | end | rpb | rem |\n|---|---:|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|\n"
		gauges.Iterate("", "", func(_ string, v any) bool {
			g := v.(*Gauge)
			accrue(g)
			on := "off"
			if g.On {
				on = "on"
			}
			out += ufmt.Sprintf("| `%s` | %d | %d | %s | %d | %d | %d |\n", sanitize.InlineText(g.ID), g.Acc, g.TotalFunded, on, g.EndH, g.RewardPerBlock, g.Remaining)
			return false
		})
		out += "\n"
	}

	out += "## Fund\n\n"
	out += "Attach `ugnot` with the tx. Lump credit to Acc (duration 0). Any EOA can incentivize a live pool (`totalLP > 0`).\n\n"
	out += "<gno-form exec=\"Fund\">\n"
	out += "<gno-input name=\"poolID\" placeholder=\"ugnot|SYMBOL\" required=\"true\" />\n"
	out += "</gno-form>\n\n"

	out += "## FundProgram\n\n"
	out += "Timed emission. `durationBlocks >= 28800`. Acc grows on accrue, not at deposit.\n\n"
	out += "<gno-form exec=\"FundProgram\">\n"
	out += "<gno-input name=\"poolID\" placeholder=\"ugnot|SYMBOL\" required=\"true\" />\n"
	out += "<gno-input name=\"durationBlocks\" placeholder=\"28800\" required=\"true\" />\n"
	out += "</gno-form>\n\n"

	out += "## Claim\n\n"
	out += "Settles LastLP then snapshots current PositionOf. Works when paused or gauge off.\n\n"
	out += "<gno-form exec=\"Claim\">\n"
	out += "<gno-input name=\"poolID\" placeholder=\"ugnot|SYMBOL\" required=\"true\" />\n"
	out += "</gno-form>\n"
	return out
}
